description: Features 4 + 5 — Educational fasting-stage timeline AND achievements/milestones. Both are education/gamification surfaces built on pure lib logic + Stats/Home UI with NO Dexie schema change, so they ship together. (4) Enrich src/lib/stages.ts with per-stage educational copy + a tip and a pure timelineForElapsed helper, then an interactive timeline UI on Home near StageIndicator. (5) NEW pure src/lib/achievements.ts deriving unlocked milestones purely from Dexie history + stats (NEVER persisting badge state), then an achievements grid under a nested Stats route (/stats/pencapaian) with unlocked/locked cards + progress. Depends on FEAT-001 for the shared foundation; logic depends on existing stages.ts/stats.ts.
steps: Read FIRST: the absolute context.json and this file, plus src/lib/stages.ts and src/lib/stats.ts (Totals/Streaks). Keep stageForElapsed/STAGE_LIST behavior unchanged.

TIMELINE — src/lib/stages.ts: extend the Stage interface with `whatHappens: string` and `tip: string`, sourced from NEW copy.stages.*What / copy.stages.*Tip strings (add them in src/lib/copy.ts, Gojek voice, no emoji) for all five stages, wired into the existing STAGES array entries. Add a pure helper `timelineForElapsed(elapsedMs: number): { stage: Stage; state: "passed" | "current" | "upcoming" }[]` returning all stages in order with each marked relative to the live elapsed hours (passed = fully behind, current = the stage stageForElapsed returns, upcoming = ahead). Pure + deterministic.

src/lib/__tests__/stages.test.ts: add cases for timelineForElapsed at boundaries (0h, 4h, 12h, 16h, 24h) asserting exactly one 'current' and correct passed/upcoming partition; confirm existing stageForElapsed expectations are untouched.

Create src/features/timer/StageTimeline.tsx ('use client'): an interactive/expandable timeline track (motion) rendering timelineForElapsed(elapsedMs); each node shows the stage icon (via Icon choke point, reusing existing stage_* IconKeys), label, hour threshold, whatHappens, and tip, with the current stage highlighted and passed/upcoming styled distinctly; iOS light+dark via tokens. Mount it on Home (src/features/timer/FastingTimer.tsx) near StageIndicator as an expandable section; feed it the same t.elapsedMs already computed there.

ACHIEVEMENTS — create pure src/lib/achievements.ts (NO React, NO @/db; import Totals/Streaks helpers or accept precomputed values + FastingSessionRecord[]; IconKey from @/types; copy from @/lib/copy). Define `interface Achievement { id: string; title: string; description: string; icon: IconKey; isUnlocked(ctx): boolean; progress?(ctx): number }` and an evaluator `evaluateAchievements(ctx: { sessions: FastingSessionRecord[]; now: number }): { achievement: Achievement; unlocked: boolean; progress: number }[]`. Milestones: first fast, first 18h fast, 7-day streak, 30-day streak, total 100 hours, 10/50/100 total fasts, and a longest-single-fast milestone. Derive everything from history + stats (streaks(sessions, now) + totals(sessions)); DO NOT persist any badge state.
src/lib/copy.ts: add an `achievements` namespace with emoji-free titles + descriptions for each milestone.

src/types/index.ts + src/components/ui/Icon.tsx: add IconKeys `achievement -> IoTrophyOutline`, `achievement_locked -> IoLockClosedOutline`, `milestone -> IoMedalOutline`, `ribbon -> IoRibbonOutline` (verified io5). Keep `satisfies`.

src/lib/__tests__/achievements.test.ts: assert each milestone's exact unlock boundary (just-below locked, at/above unlocked), progress calculation for the countable ones, and empty history (none unlocked, progress 0).

Create src/app/stats/pencapaian/page.tsx (thin 'use client' host) rendering src/features/achievements/AchievementsGrid.tsx ('use client', useLiveQuery for sessions, calls evaluateAchievements): unlocked vs locked cards with progress bars (div/SVG + motion, iOS cards; follow WeeklyBarChart scaling for the bars), icons via the choke point. Nested under /stats so the tab bar shows unchanged (do NOT touch layout files). Add a summary entry Card on src/features/stats/StatsOverview.tsx (e.g. 'Pencapaian' with unlocked count) linking to /stats/pencapaian.
Optional: a subtle unlock toast when a freshly completed fast crosses a boundary — derive by comparing evaluations WITHOUT persisting badge state.
acceptance_criteria: src/lib/stages.ts gains whatHappens/tip + timelineForElapsed; stageForElapsed/STAGE_LIST behavior is unchanged and existing stage tests still pass.
A timeline UI on Home marks passed/current/upcoming stages with educational copy + tips; icons via the Icon choke point; iOS light+dark.
src/lib/achievements.ts derives unlocked milestones purely from history + stats and persists NO badge state; `/stats/pencapaian` shows unlocked vs locked with progress.
`npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/stages.test.ts src/lib/__tests__/achievements.test.ts` passes (boundaries + empty history).
`npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npm run build` succeeds; layout files unchanged vs HEAD; no-emoji scan green.
findings:
Feature 4 (timeline): extended Stage with whatHappens/tip sourced from new copy.stages.*What/*Tip (Gojek voice, no emoji) and added pure timelineForElapsed(elapsedMs): TimelineEntry[] marking passed/current/upcoming by partitioning STAGES around the stageForElapsed result (exactly one 'current'). stageForElapsed/STAGE_LIST behavior unchanged; existing stage tests stay green. New StageTimeline.tsx ('use client', div/SVG + motion, no charting lib) renders an expandable educational track with the stage_* icons via the Icon choke point; mounted on Home (FastingTimer.tsx) under StageIndicator, fed the same t.elapsedMs. Added copy.timer.timelineTitle/timelineNow.

Feature 5 (achievements): new pure src/lib/achievements.ts (no React, no @/db) deriving milestones purely from history via streaks(sessions, now) + totals(sessions) + a single pass over durations; NO badge state persisted. Catalog: first_fast, first_18h, fasts_10/50/100, streak_7/30, hours_100, longest_fast (24h). evaluateAchievements({sessions, now}) returns {achievement, unlocked, progress(0..1)}; unlockedCount helper. New IconKeys achievement->IoTrophyOutline, achievement_locked->IoLockClosedOutline, milestone->IoMedalOutline, ribbon->IoRibbonOutline (verified io5), satisfies kept. New copy.achievements namespace. AchievementsGrid.tsx ('use client', useLiveQuery) splits unlocked/locked cards with WeeklyBarChart-style scaled progress bars (motion), icons via choke point; hosted by new nested route src/app/stats/pencapaian/page.tsx (tab bar preserved via /stats startsWith; no layout files touched). StatsOverview gained a 'Pencapaian' summary card linking to the route.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit clean; targeted stages+achievements tests pass (20 + 11); full suite 253 passed across 12 files (baseline 185 only grew; no-emoji scan 87 green); npm run lint 0 errors (2 pre-existing warnings in notifications.ts/recommendation.ts, untouched); npm run build succeeded and prerendered /stats/pencapaian. Layout files (Chrome/layout/AppShell/BottomTabBar) show empty diff vs HEAD.
